summary: Completed comprehensive testing of password-based authentication for Khurpi Microgreens app. All backend API tests passed (14/14). All frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: User Signup, User Login, User Change Password, Admin Reset Password, Admin Login. No 'Forgot Password' link on login page as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Password hashing using bcrypt (passlib) is properly implemented
All password endpoints validate minimum 6 character length
Password is correctly excluded from API responses
Admin reset password endpoint properly validates user existence
All data-testid attributes are correctly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Test users with 'TEST_' prefix were created and cleaned up during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password-based authentication fully tested. OTP code remains in backend but is not used by frontend. All data-testid selectors work correctly: login-phone-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, signup-name-input, signup-phone-input, signup-password-input, signup-confirm-password-input, signup-submit-button, open-change-password-btn, current-password-input, new-password-input, confirm-new-password-input, change-password-submit, admin-username-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit-button, reset-password-button-{userId}, admin-reset-password-input, admin-reset-confirm-input, admin-reset-password-submit

USER_SIGNUP.details: User can signup with phone, name, and password. Duplicate phone correctly rejected. Password stored hashed.

USER_LOGIN.details: User can login with phone and password. Wrong password/non-existent user correctly rejected with 401.

USER_CHANGE_PASSWORD.details: User can change password from Profile page. Current password verified. New password must be 6+ chars. Old password stops working after change.

ADMIN_RESET_PASSWORD.details: Admin can reset any user's password from Admin Users page. New password must be 6+ chars. User can login with new password.

ADMIN_LOGIN.details: Admin can login with username=admin, password=admin. Wrong credentials correctly rejected.

NO_FORGOT_PASSWORD.details: Login page does NOT have 'Forgot Password' link as per requirements.

elements: User cards with Edit, Reset Pwd, Delete buttons

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs - all authentication operations use real backend endpoints
